prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1275; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with whiplash-type mechanism. Across four visits, the patient was managed with a standard conservative course including range-of-motion exercises, manual therapy, and home stretching guidance. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the cervical region, with restricted rotation and tenderness on palpation. The patient reports no prior injury to the neck or upper back, and none is known from available records. Treatment followed a usual trajectory, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and function returned. Billing records show no repeated charges for the same services. Whether the present symptoms are fully attributable to this collision remains unclear and will be reassessed at follow-up.
